description: A Python module defining MCPClient class for interacting with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, facilitating integration with external tools and resources for LLMs. Includes methods for listing and registering tools, converting schemas, and handling different server connection types.

classes.name: MCPClient
classes.description: Client for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling external tool integration with LLMs via various server connection types.

methods.name: ToolsSchema register_tools(self, llm: LLMService | LLMSwitcher)
methods.description: Registers all available MCP tools with an LLM service by discovering tools, converting schemas, and registering them.

methods.name: ToolsSchema get_tools_schema(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the schema of all available MCP tools without registering them.

methods.name: None register_tools_schema( self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema, llm: LLMService | LLMSwitcher )
methods.description: Registers provided MCP tools schemas with the LLM service.

methods.name: FunctionSchema _convert_mcp_schema_to_pipecat( self, tool_name: str, tool_schema: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Converts an MCP tool schema to Pipecat's FunctionSchema format.

methods.name: ToolsSchema _sse_list_tools(self)
methods.description: Lists all available MCP tools over SSE server connection.

methods.name: None _sse_tool_wrapper(self, params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Wrapper for executing MCP tools over SSE connection.

methods.name: ToolsSchema _stdio_list_tools(self)
methods.description: Lists MCP tools over stdio connection.

methods.name: None _stdio_tool_wrapper(self, params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Wrapper for executing MCP tools over stdio connection.

methods.name: ToolsSchema _streamable_http_list_tools(self)
methods.description: Lists MCP tools over streamable HTTP connection.

methods.name: None _streamable_http_tool_wrapper(self, params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Wrapper for executing MCP tools over streamable HTTP.

methods.name: _call_tool(self, session, function_name, arguments, result_callback)
methods.description: Executes an MCP tool within a session, handling responses and applying output filters.

methods.name: _list_tools_helper(self, session)
methods.description: Helper method to list available tools from a session and convert their schemas.
